acceptable_paraphrases: Each rotation brings the decagon to a position indistinguishable from its original position
A regular decagon has 10-fold rotational symmetry with an angle of 36° per rotation
critical_errors: incorrectly stating the number of sides or name
misconceptions: stating the angle of rotation as 36 degrees without reference to full turn
believing that a regular decagon has fewer or more than 10 sides
mentioning reflectional symmetry instead of rotational symmetry
grading_notes: Credit for including all required concepts and using strict keywords. Points deducted for critical errors, optional concepts not included, or showing misconceptions.
